title: Income Tax Act
verified_how: Fetched the index page: title 'Income Tax Act', citation (R.S.C., 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.)), current to 2026-07-21, last amended 2026-06-18.
notes: Covers federal personal income tax and employer source deductions (s. 153), and also the Canada child benefit. Provincial income tax sits in provincial Acts, although CRA collects it for most provinces. CPP and EI withholding are in their own Acts.
repository_commit_message: Laws Site Update 2026-10-15: Acts and regulations current to September 30, 2026 on the Laws site.
